name: Mission: Possible But Not Probable
summary: In the northern Barrens, Horde rogues face a Venture Company outpost that tests stealth, theft, and combat. They infiltrate an oil tower, kill Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix, and take a potent chemical brew for the Shattered Hand.

sections.title: Infiltration of the Venture Co.
sections.body: North of the Sludge Fen oil rigs, the Venture Company keeps an isolated drilling tower. Taskmaster Fizzule, a Shattered Hand operative posing as a Venture Company supervisor, orders rogues to rely on underworld craft instead of an open assault. He asks them to pick the key from Foreman Silixiz and keep it for him. Then they climb past workers and sentries changed by the tower’s experiments.

sections.title: A Chemical Catastrophe
sections.body: An experimental substance called Zanzil's Altered Mixture has changed the tower’s inhabitants. The venom weakens the guards, leaving them open to swift strikes, bleeding attacks, and sudden ambushes. It has also made the facility volatile. At the summit, Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix guards a lockbox holding the brew.

sections.title: The Price of Duty
sections.body: The altered mixture’s vapors escape when the rogue opens Gallywix’s lockbox. They break stealth, sap vitality, and leave a debilitating affliction that lasts a long time. Back in Orgrimmar, Shenthul, the Shattered Hand mentor, receives Gallywix’s head and the chemical sample. He mourns Fizzule’s compromised position and sends the dying agent to seek a cure.

faq.q: Where is the Venture Co. Tower located?
faq.answer: The Venture Company tower stands in the northern Barrens, just north of the Sludge Fen drilling operation. Hostile Venture Company workers surround it, and Taskmaster Fizzule hides near a tree just to the east.

faq.q: How do you obtain the key to the tower?
faq.answer: Foreman Silixiz carries the tower key and wanders the grounds outside its base. Pick his pocket while hidden to take it; killing him will not yield the key.

Zanzil's Altered Mixture is an alchemical brew drawn from the formulas of the notorious troll witch doctor Zanzil. The Venture Company acquired it, and its unstable fumes poisoned the tower’s workforce, leaving them sickly, mutated, and vulnerable to rogue combat arts.

faq.q: Why am I unable to stealth after opening the lockbox?
faq.answer: Opening Gallywix’s lockbox releases concentrated fumes from the altered mixture. The toxic affliction lasts for days, weakens your attributes, and breaks your stealth until an experienced apothecary cures it.

Taskmaster Fizzule is a deep-cover operative for the Shattered Hand, the Horde’s rogue guild. The Dark Iron dwarf poses as a ruthless Venture Company taskmaster in the Barrens and directs recruits to sabotage the company’s assets without exposing himself.

faq.q: Who is Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix?
faq.answer: Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix is the goblin overseer who commands the Venture Company tower near Sludge Fen. He guards the stolen cache of Zanzil's concoction until Shattered Hand operatives kill him.

angles.text: As a rogue, you learn field skills in lockpicking, pickpocketing, and exploiting vulnerabilities. These skills open the way to the Shattered Hand’s deadly craft and poisons.
The Shattered Hand works in Orgrimmar’s shadows, watching dangerous corporate intruders such as the Venture Company as they exploit the Barrens.
